notes.title: Get ready! 2P Battle Mode drops on June 9!
notes.content:
June 9 – Steam Next Fest | Brand-New 2P Battle Mode! 🎮💥🎮

Get ready to battle your friends in a variety of exciting game modes, including Grab the Star, Eating Contest, and Ring Rumble! Use different items to outsmart (or sabotage!) your opponents and amp up the fun. With Remote Play Together, you can enjoy the chaos together with your friend anytime, anywhere!

The 2P Battle Mode will be available for a limited time only—from June 9 to June 22. Don’t miss your chance to dive in, whether it's for some lighthearted fun or total mayhem with friends!

And don’t forget to add Rocket Penguin to your Wishlist to stay up to date with the latest news! ⭐
See you at Steam Next Fest!

notes.title: The Rocket Penguin demo is coming soon! (Release date changed to 3/7 GMT+8.)
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45500569/9c22ff10549dcd29ef70e47ba182440ec67802bf.png[/img]

Hello everyone!

We are RetroFiveGames, and we're so excited to announce that our game Rocket Penguin will be available on Steam!

The demo version will be released on March 7th (GMT+8). We apologize for the delay and appreciate your understanding. Stay tuned!

The initial concept for Rocket Penguin was conceived in 2018, with an early idea for the gameplay. However, due to work commitments, development didn’t truly begin until 2022. Throughout development, we encountered many challenges and continuously explored different game mechanics. After countless tests and adjustments, we’ve finally crafted a game that we’re truly satisfied with.

If you're interested, please add the game to your wishlist!
Your support will be our greatest motivation to keep creating!

Thanks!
